verdicts.reason: Cited netlink macros/enums and rtnetlink message types directly match membership, extended ack error attributes, and link/route operations.
USB endpoint helpers and vfio_region_info match, but opal_table_ops is an enum of read/write operations rather than table descriptors.
The five cited UAPI structs directly define boot screen info, system info, versioned taskstats, openat2 config, and UTS node names.
Fragments show TEE open/invoke, VFIO migration states, and plug buffer/release-one, but omit symbols for TEE close and indefinite plug release.

overall: Mostly accurate UAPI symbol mappings; minor overstatements in Finding 2 (Opal ops vs descriptors) and Finding 4 (missing citations for TEE close and indefinite release).
